results.detail: The stated facts are correct. That covers the isFileExist trigger (Check File Existence ScriptMain.cs:308-325; Constraints 4/5/6 at DTSX:8057-8059, with 5 and 6 OR). It also covers the MF Source design-time path with the config caveat (DTSX:11, 33), the inner join to product with the ownership argument (0004:37558/37568/37617/70147/70153 checked), and the 'ערך' wording with the meaning labelled השערה. Part (2) is correct too: all accounts by LEFT JOIN, 0 when there is no balance, direct UPDATE dbo.AccountBase (Unsupported, DTSX:7991-7994) when a stored value is NULL or different, and the NULL-fee failure condition (Check if to update orders 0-3, all FailComponent, DTSX:7744-7772). MISSING: part (1) gives the update condition only as 'שמקושרות למוצר ... בתנאי שאחד התוקפים חל'. It leaves out the product-type filter that decides which gen_employers records are written. Only records whose ProductTypeCode is 200001/1 (Pension Fund) or 200000/2 (Study Fund) continue. A record of any other non-NULL type goes to 'DE Output', which has no path, so it is never updated even when a validity condition holds. A NULL type fails the data flow, so part (2) does not run in that run. The text 'ערך הצבירה לפי סוג המוצר (עמודת גמל או השתלמות)' only implies this.

wrongUnits.problem: Missing row-selection condition: the product type. Records with another product type are silently skipped, and a NULL type fails the step.
wrongUnits.correct: Only gen_employers records whose product has ProductTypeCode 200001/1 or 200000/2 are updated. Other types are skipped without documentation. A NULL ProductTypeCode fails the data flow (FailComponent), and then the archive and the account calculation do not run.

results.detail: Check If Date Valid: order 0 'Deposit Date Valid' = !ISNULL(gen_mfdepositstartdate) && gen_mfdepositstartdate < GETDATE(). Order 1 'MF Accumulation Date Valid' = all three accumulation values present && start < GETDATE() && end > GETDATE(). Both outputs go to Union All 1 and then to Create. Create sets every non-NULL field (main.cs:127-136) with no further check. So a row valid by deposit also writes an accumulation value whose period has ended or not started. A row valid by accumulation also writes a deposit value whose start date is in the future (or NULL). The text is conditional and not framed as a bug.

The title has the MF meaning labelled השערה. short_he is verified: the inner join to product, several records per corporate number, and the management-fee wording with an explicit השערה label. The ownership argument is checked against 0004:37558/37568/37617/70147/70153. flow_he[1] is TRIM + convert ((DT_DBTIMESTAMP)/(DT_R8)). flow_he[2] is Merge Join JoinType=1 (DTSX:5732). flow_he[3] is ISNULL(Gen_employersid), which leads to the warning 'מעסיק לא נמצא במאגר הנתונים'. flow_he[4] is Check Fund type 200001/1 → provident_fund, 200000/2 → study_fund, DE Output with no path, and NULL → FailComponent. flow_he[5] is the OR validity check. flow_he[6] is ExecuteMultiple Update of non-NULL fields. The product-type filter that the summary lacks is present here in flow_he[4].

[2]/[4]: a record must have a product to be fetched (inner join). The warning is raised even when product-less records exist, and ownership is argued. Pension Fund (200001/1) takes provident_fund and Study Fund (200000/2) takes study_fund. Other types are skipped and NULL fails.
